name: TEM-1 Activity Screen Manual Nitro R3 v1 Skip Working Solutions
description: Manual-nitro Round 3 v1 TEM-1 activity screen with working-solution preparation skipped. The robot loads the assay plate, seals before shaking, incubates sealed for 10 minutes, and stops before manual nitrocefin addition.

nodes.label: Pick Up Pipette
nodes.description: Pick up the starting pipette. Transfer helpers swap to the correct pipette by volume.

nodes.label: Dispense TEM-1 Prep
nodes.description: Add 40 uL manually prepared TEM-1 working solution to positive-control and test-compound wells in batches.

nodes.label: Dispense No-Enzyme Prep
nodes.description: Add 40 uL BLB/no-enzyme prep to negative-control wells in one batch.

nodes.label: Dispense Vehicle
nodes.description: Add 10 uL prepared matched vehicle to no-enzyme controls in one batch.

nodes.label: Dispense Positive Control
nodes.description: Add 10 uL prepared positive-control working solution to positive-control wells in batches.

nodes.label: Dispense Test Compound 1
nodes.description: Add prepared T1262 compound 1 to its three replicate wells in batches.

nodes.label: Dispense Test Compound 2
nodes.description: Add prepared T6685 compound 2 to its three replicate wells in batches.

nodes.label: Dispense Test Compound 3
nodes.description: Add prepared T14081 compound 3 to its three replicate wells in batches.

nodes.label: Dispense Test Compound 4
nodes.description: Add prepared T1008 compound 4 to its three replicate wells in batches.

nodes.label: Dispense Test Compound 5
nodes.description: Add prepared T0224 compound 5 to its three replicate wells in batches.

nodes.label: Dispense Test Compound 6
nodes.description: Add prepared T0985 compound 6 to its three replicate wells in batches.

nodes.label: Dispense Test Compound 7
nodes.description: Add prepared T0138 compound 7 to its three replicate wells in batches.

nodes.label: Dispense Test Compound 8
nodes.description: Add prepared T8390 compound 8 to its three replicate wells in batches.

nodes.label: Place Pipette Back
nodes.description: Return whichever pipette is currently in hand to its stand before sealing.

nodes.label: Seal Plate
nodes.description: Seal the assay plate on the PlateMax and return it to the home fixture.

nodes.label: Ensure Shaker Off
nodes.description: Turn the shaker off if it is currently running before loading the sealed plate.

nodes.label: Open Shaker Lid
nodes.description: Open the shaker lid.

nodes.label: Grab Sealed Plate
nodes.description: Pick up the sealed assay plate short-side for transfer to the shaker.

nodes.label: Load Sealed Plate Into Shaker
nodes.description: Load the sealed assay plate into the selected shaker slot.

nodes.label: Close Shaker Lid
nodes.description: Close the shaker lid before mixing.

nodes.label: Start Shaker Mix
nodes.description: Start the shaker for whole-plate mixing.

nodes.label: Wait for Plate Mix
nodes.description: Run the shaker for the configured plate-mixing duration.

nodes.label: Stop Shaker Mix
nodes.description: Stop the shaker after mixing.

nodes.label: Open Shaker After Mix
nodes.description: Open the shaker so the sealed plate can be unloaded.

nodes.label: Unload Mixed Sealed Plate
nodes.description: Unload the sealed assay plate from the shaker.

nodes.label: Close Shaker After Mix
nodes.description: Close the shaker lid after unloading the plate.

nodes.label: Return Sealed Plate
nodes.description: Return the sealed assay plate to its home fixture for incubation.

nodes.label: Sealed Pre-Incubation
nodes.description: Incubate the sealed assay plate for 10 minutes before the operator manually unseals and adds nitrocefin outside the workflow.

nodes.label: Save Run Folder
nodes.description: Bundle the run log and timing artifacts into a named data folder. The protocol stops here for manual unseal and nitrocefin addition.
